scope: Entire local enterprise-qa package and proposed engineering/MCP extensions
basis: Source inspection and local regression tests; not a live production audit

findings.title: Performance execution lacked a full engineering lifecycle
findings.resolution: Added dedicated engineering coordinator and workload/correlation/bottleneck/retest specialists.
findings.next_action: Exercise the lifecycle against an approved application baseline.

findings.title: Workload validity and baseline comparability were underspecified
findings.resolution: Added open/closed models, units, generator saturation, sampling/coordinated-omission caveats and percentile comparison rules.
findings.next_action: Supply documented SLOs and a comparable baseline before pass/fail or capacity claims.

findings.title: Cause scores could be mistaken for confirmed root cause
findings.resolution: Separated suspected/probable/confirmed with mechanism proof and logs/traces/metrics/code agreement; added structural preflight.
findings.next_action: Validate actual evidence credibility; local JSON checks cannot prove causality.

findings.title: Fix review, rollback and post-fix validation had no dedicated roles
findings.resolution: Added fix-proposal, approval-bound implementation and performance retest specialists.
findings.next_action: Review a concrete proposal before approving any application change.

findings.title: No product-specific MCP responsibilities or deployment boundaries
findings.resolution: Added separate Splunk, Dynatrace, NeoLoad, Jira and Confluence skills/agents and documented vendor templates.
findings.next_action: Choose deployment/version/region/auth references during setup.

findings.title: No cross-tool correlation or query completeness contract
findings.resolution: Added IDs/time windows/entities/revisions/clock uncertainty, explicit budgets, pagination and missing-source handling.
findings.next_action: Confirm bounded query budgets and mappings for each environment.

findings.title: Meta-tool actions and uncertain writes needed explicit handling
findings.resolution: Require nested-action discovery/effect classification, exact approvals, launch/write reconciliation and no blind retries.
findings.next_action: Test connector-specific read/denial/timeout/unknown-write scenarios with mocks or approved fixtures.

findings.title: Jira/Confluence publishing lacked duplication, field and concurrency rules
findings.resolution: Added duplicate search, issue metadata, page-version-aware updates, visibility/redaction and publication receipts.
findings.next_action: Select site/project/space/destination and approve each concrete write.

findings.title: Output boundary was checked after directory creation
findings.resolution: Added nearest-existing-ancestor validation before mkdir plus post-check; escaping symlink regression test.
findings.next_action: Use workspace ACLs to protect against concurrent filesystem tampering.

findings.title: Page-controlled payloads could overwrite evidence fields or bypass masked resource policy
findings.evidence: recorder/src/recorder.ts (v1 exposed binding and payload spread)
findings.resolution: Added explicit event-kind/field allowlist, upload size/base64 checks and masked-file omission before persistence.
findings.next_action: Treat recorded page events as untrusted observations, not authenticated attestations.

findings.title: Explicit stop reason and event URL could be overwritten by later browser state
findings.evidence: recorder/src/recorder.ts (v1 page close and queued action)
findings.resolution: Preserve explicit-stop and capture URL/page identity before screenshot queue; added stop-reason assertion.
findings.next_action: Continue reporting screenshot-time races rather than promising event-instant capture.

findings.title: Broad source traversal could copy undeclared secrets or a nested target workspace
findings.resolution: Install only checksum-listed owned files; reject nested target/source escapes.
findings.next_action: Review distribution list before publishing; checksums are not publisher signatures.

findings.title: No safe managed-update path existed for installed definitions
findings.resolution: Added install receipt and opt-in --update-managed; update only unchanged previously owned files, preserving user edits.
findings.next_action: Preview updates; manually review legacy installs without ownership receipts.

findings.title: Malformed versions, duplicate indexes or external JSON symlinks could undermine evidence checks
findings.evidence: scripts/check_gate.py (v1 current-case map and JSON loading)
findings.resolution: Reject duplicate indexes, non-integer/boolean versions and out-of-root records; added regression tests.
findings.next_action: Use signed attestations if records need protection from deliberate local forgery.

findings.title: Confirmed cleanup could remove evidence from a still-running recorder
findings.resolution: Record process ID; refuse cleanup of unfinished active/unknown sessions while retaining exact-path confirmation.
findings.next_action: Use a stronger process/session lock if PID reuse or multi-user hosts matter.

findings.title: Approvals and execution prerequisites remain agent policy/local JSON
findings.resolution: Added scoped content-digest checks, but no host hook or signed authorization service.
findings.next_action: Approve host-specific hooks/read-only tool allowlists or an authenticated policy gateway; define identity and revocation first.

findings.title: Screenshot masking cannot guarantee removal of arbitrary customer data
findings.evidence: recorder/src/recorder.ts screenshot mask logic and docs/RECORDER.md
findings.resolution: Preserved conservative input/API redaction and explicit limitations; production monitoring defaults to aggregates/redacted references.
findings.next_action: Approve application-specific selectors, publication review and fixture-based visual redaction acceptance tests; consider omit-screenshot mode.

findings.title: Fast navigation, closed frames and native gestures can leave screenshot/action gaps
findings.resolution: Explicit screenshot errors and observed event URL are retained; no claim of exhaustive capture.
findings.next_action: Choose an approved queue/backpressure strategy and optional trace/video capture; define acceptance for shadow DOM/canvas/native dialogs.

findings.title: The stored-resource cap does not bound all browser/temp memory/disk or dishonest body lengths
findings.evidence: recorder/src/budget.ts and response.body use in recorder.ts
findings.resolution: Stored payload budget remains strict; unknown-size/compressed body omissions are documented.
findings.next_action: Approve a bounded streaming capture design and separate screenshot/profile/export budgets if hard process quotas are required.

findings.title: Crash recovery and multi-file knowledge updates lack transactional guarantees
findings.resolution: Completion remains explicitly awaiting clarification; partial-state and resume limitations are documented.
findings.next_action: Approve checkpoint/atomic-write/journal design and retained-profile lock handling; test abrupt process termination.

findings.title: Templates and vendor docs do not prove tenant capabilities or access
findings.resolution: Provided edition/version-aware discovery and bounded read acceptance procedure; no live services queried.
findings.next_action: Connect approved tenants, discover exact schemas and validate read-only fixtures before enabling writes or load execution.

findings.title: Native IDE discovery and Windows/Linux behavior remain unverified
findings.resolution: Generated native role adapters and portable fallbacks; validated source/metadata locally.
findings.next_action: Run a cross-platform/client acceptance matrix; verify duplicate-skill discovery and supported secret/auth behavior.
